implementation.build: Tracked HEAD export plus these selected changes; unrelated unfinished model-transport worktree edits were excluded from the compiled/tested/deployed binary.
implementation.query: lake --no-ansi --json query +Module +Module:lean +Module:olean +Module:setup, for all selected roots in one invocation
implementation.protocol: One bounded JSON line per target, maximum 64 MiB/line, exact result count and successful actual process exit; incomplete/nonzero/extra/oversized output cannot return a fingerprint. Unfinished queries are killed/reaped. Anonymous targets preserve ordinary root builds. Actual compiler setup replaces the server setup projection; every original setup field and input byte remains hashed.
implementation.cache: Compiler/resource identities change, so an initial raw-observation cache fill is required; there is no compatibility relabel or hash/mtime shortcut.
implementation.ui: Command activity retains generation and pending count, so completion of a background directory command wakes a queued explicit file read even when React batches the visible busy/idle boolean. Each refresh must dispatch exactly one requested-file inspection.
implementation.test_fixture: The copied-worker mutation test makes only its owned temporary copy writable. The immutable original remains unchanged; post-preparation tampering is refused before solver dispatch.

manifest.limits: Current-user native host and inherited workers only; no kernel stacks. Thread CPU spans exclude worker CPU. File preparation reuses project/OS caches, not a cold installation. Sampling changes timing; browser profiles have their own overhead.
